findings.summary: The decode-and-recheck branch is unreachable under the preceding static filename regexp.
findings.consequence: The function appears to protect against percent-encoded traversal and control characters, but the regexp on line 176 already rejects percent signs, slashes, backslashes, controls, non-ASCII, and leading dots. Future changes may assume this branch is carrying real policy when it currently cannot observe different input.
findings.evidence: SAFE_STATIC_FILENAME is /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,499}$/u, so any value reaching line 177 contains no percent escapes, no path separators, no controls, no surrogates, and cannot be '.' or '..'. The direct callers in reader-source-info-definitions.ts and reader-source-info-sanitizer.ts only need a strict local static basename.
findings.recommendation: Either reduce safeStaticFilename to the single regexp check, or intentionally allow percent-encoded basenames in the regexp and keep the decoded-path checks as active policy with tests for encoded static filenames.
